# `Q-13-15` — Announcement references missing document

> A link in the `website.announcement` content points at a document
> that is not in the project's render index.

## What this means

The announcement banner's `content` is markdown, so it can link to
other pages of the site, for example
`content: "See the [release notes](news.qmd)."`. Each link that
names a document is looked up in the project index at render time,
and rewritten to the page's output URL. This warning fires when the
name does not appear in that index. The banner still renders, but
the link does not lead anywhere useful.

Link paths in the announcement are relative to the project root,
like other links written in `_quarto.yml`.

## Why this happens

Same family of causes as `Q-13-1` (sidebar missing document):

- **A typo** in the file name.
- **A renamed or deleted** document.
- **An excluded file** that is not part of the render set.
- **A path written relative to the page** rather than to the project
  root.

## How to fix

Point the link at a file that is in the render set, or add the
missing file. The message names the missing path.
